object.name: evi.filter.bell~
object.description: The bell filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...bandwidth at -3dB/+3dB from center freq'. Also with analog 'adaptive Q' option.
object.discussion: For more information about TPT SVFs and other filter types in evieve see the 'evieve filter' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: ± gain in dB. The effect of gain depends on the @adaptive attribute.
Q, clamped in the range 0.05..20. The effect of Q depends on the @adaptive attribute.

attributes.name: adaptive
attributes.description: Off by default means that the response of the filter will be like that of a classic RBJ peak/notch. If @adaptive is on the gain of the filter affects the Q of the filter whereby higher gain will cause steeper Q and vica versa. This is as would be the case in an analog filter.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smooth the mixing gains of the filter efficiently at the core of the DSP. With these TPT SVF filters this will usually be the only smoothing required. By default smoothing is off.
